title: Evidence
subtitle: What has to work in your app, recorded once by an agent and replayed on every environment.

status_hint.draft: No agent has recorded it yet, so it can't run.
status_hint.ready: Recorded, waiting for its first run.
status_hint.pass: Every check passed on the last run.
status_hint.fail: A check failed on the last run.
status_hint.blocked: A step failed before a check could run.
status_hint.error: The run never got to test anything. Open it to see why.

case_form.title: Title
case_form.description_hint: in your words, as you would tell a colleague
case_form.description_placeholder: A shopper with a valid code sees the discount before paying.
case_form.steps_placeholder:
1. Add a product to the cart
2. Type SAVE10 in the discount box
3. Press Apply
case_form.expected_placeholder: The total drops by 10% and the code shows as applied.
case_form.created: {key} created. Next, have an agent record it.

delete.title: Delete {key}?
delete.message: “{title}” goes away with all its runs, videos and captures. This can't be undone.

detail.draft_title: Nobody has recorded this case yet
detail.draft_body: An agent opens the app on the environment you pick, follows the steps and films them once. After that the case runs by itself, without the agent.
detail.draft_no_env: First add an environment in the Environments tab: that is where the agent records.
detail.in_progress: This run is in progress. The video shows up when it finishes.
detail.never_ran: Recorded but not run yet. Run it on an environment to get a video.
detail.video_aria: Video of the latest run of {key}

empty.title: Start your library of cases
empty.step1_body: In plain words: what a person does and what they should see. No code.
empty.step2_body: It opens your app on an environment, follows the steps and films them with checks.
empty.step3_body: After every deploy, on a schedule or when you press Run. Each run leaves a video and a pass or fail.

env_form.name: Name
env_form.url_invalid: Write a full address that starts with http:// or https://.
env_form.hosts_hint: one per line: login provider, CDN
env_form.logins_hint: Accounts the agent and the runs type in when the app asks for them. Use test accounts only: once saved, nobody can read a value back.
env_form.login_invalid: Each test login needs a name (capital letters, digits and _) and a value.
env_form.cron_invalid: Write five fields separated by spaces, like 0 9 * * 1-5.
env_form.preview_off: Runs only when someone starts it or after a deploy.
env_form.deploy_on: Run every recorded case after a successful deploy on GitHub
env_form.hook_after_save: Save the environment to get its id. The command will read:
env_form.hook_hint: Any pipeline can start the runs with this command. Keep an API key in OCTOPUS_API_KEY.
env_form.hook_key_link: Create an API key (opens in a new tab)
env_form.kind_project_hint: Runs this project's cases and the ones without a project, and shows on the project page.
env_form.kind_standalone_hint: Any address. Every case can run here.
env_form.slug_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or _, starting with a letter or digit (40 at most).
env_form.production_hint: Only workspace admins can change a production environment, and runs never pick it by default.
env_form.production_on_project: Mark it as production on the project page.
env_form.production_on_project_ask: Only workspace admins can mark it as production, on the project page.
env_form.sandbox_lead: The Sandbox starts fresh for every batch from the project's init script. Here you set the other sites it may open and the test logins.
env_form.deploy_info: Listens to deploys of {repo} to the GitHub environment {environment}.
env_form.deploy_new: Listens to deploys of the project's repository to the GitHub environment with this short name.
env_form.delete_on_project: This environment belongs to its project. Delete it there.

envs.delete_message: Its schedule and its runs after deploys stop. This can't be undone.
envs.empty_body: An environment is a copy of your app the cases run against, like staging or production. Add one to record and run cases.
envs.intro: Where your cases run, and when they run by themselves.
envs.manual_only: Runs only when someone starts it
envs.other_hint: Sites outside your projects. Every case can run here.
envs.production_note: Only workspace admins can change a production environment.
envs.project_empty: This project has no environment yet.

all.one: Runs the recorded case of every project.
all.other: Runs the {count} recorded cases of every project.

project_tag.one: Runs the recorded case of {project} tagged {tag}.
project_tag.other: Runs the {count} recorded cases of {project} tagged {tag}.

schedule_scope_none.all: There are no recorded cases yet: the schedule will run nothing until you record one.
schedule_scope_none.project: {project} has no recorded cases: the schedule will run nothing until it has one.
schedule_scope_none.tag: No recorded case is tagged {tag}: the schedule will run nothing. Check the tag.
schedule_scope_none.project_tag: No recorded case of {project} is tagged {tag}: the schedule will run nothing. Check the tag.

errors.add_to_library: Couldn't add it to the library.
errors.save_logins: The environment is saved, but the test logins aren't: {error}

filters.search_placeholder: Key, title or words in the case
filters.tags_all: Shows the cases with all these tags.

pickers.no_envs: There is no environment yet. Add one first: it is where cases record and run.
pickers.none_for_case: No environment runs this case. Add one to its project or add another site.

record.title: Record with agent
record.agent_hint: one with the chat stage; the recording gives it the browser
record.lead: An agent opens the app, follows the steps of {key} · {title} and films them. You can watch and guide it in the chat.
record.lead_again: An agent records {key} · {title} again and replaces its current recording.
record.note: When the agent saves, the case runs once on the same environment so you see whether it passes.
record.started: The agent is recording {key} on {env}. Follow it in the chat.
record.no_agent: No agent has the chat stage, which recording needs.
record.no_prompt: {name} has no prompt for the Chat stage, and the recording starts with a chat.

run.title: Run on an environment
run.lead_case: Runs {key} · {title} without an agent and leaves a video.

lead_list.one: Runs the recorded case in the list.
lead_list.other: Runs the {count} recorded cases in the list.

lead_list_skipped.one: 1 recorded case in the list doesn't run on this environment and stays out.
lead_list_skipped.other: {count} recorded cases in the list don't run on this environment and stay out.

lead_list_drafts.one: 1 case still needs recording and is skipped.
lead_list_drafts.other: {count} cases still need recording and are skipped.

run.lead_env: Runs every recorded case on the environment you pick.
run.nothing: Nothing to run on {env}: no recorded case matches.
run.branch_hint: The Sandbox starts from this branch.
run.branch_required: Write the branch to start from.

runs.cancel_message: Runs that haven't started are canceled. The one running now finishes.
runs.empty_body: Runs show up here when someone starts them, on a schedule, after a deploy or from your CI.

tasks.intro: The test cases written inside tasks. Add the ones worth keeping to the library so they run on every environment.
tasks.no_matches: No test cases match these filters.
tasks.none_yet: No test cases yet. Add them from a task's drawer.
tasks.added: Added to the library as {key}. An agent still has to record it.
tasks.added_recorded: Added to the library as {key}, with its recording.

can.viewer: Your role can look but not change anything here.
can.production: Only workspace admins can change production.
can.admin_only: Only workspace admins can do this.
can.delete_on_project: Delete it on its project page.
can.sandbox_fixed: The Sandbox comes with the project and stays.
can.sandbox_no_record: The Sandbox lasts one batch. Record on an environment with an address.
can.no_init_script: The project has no init script, so the Sandbox can't start.
can.no_preview_port: The init script doesn't say which port the app listens on.
can.sandbox_unavailable: The Sandbox can't start right now.
can.repo_not_github: Runs after a deploy work only with GitHub repositories.

with_unassigned.one: Also shows 1 case without a project.
with_unassigned.other: Also shows {count} cases without a project.

link.title: Move to a project environment
link.lead: {name} becomes the environment you pick and keeps its runs, test logins and schedule.
link.hint: Only environments that have not run yet.
link.none: Every project environment already has runs. Add a new one on the project page first.

sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.about: A fresh copy of {project} for every batch, started from the branch you pick. It goes away when the batch ends.
sandbox.default_branch: Starts from {branch} unless you pick another branch
sandbox.ask_admin_write: Ask a workspace admin to add it.
sandbox.ask_admin_fix: Ask a workspace admin to fix it.
sandbox.failed_title: The Sandbox didn't start, so no case ran.
sandbox.failed_unknown: The Sandbox stopped before the app answered.
sandbox.failed_note: Check the init script, then try again.
sandbox.failed_note_ask: Ask a workspace admin to check the init script, then try again.
sandbox.failed_note_branch: Check that the branch exists, then try again.
sandbox.failed_note_busy: Every sandbox was busy. Try again in a few minutes.
sandbox.failed_note_octopus: The problem is on Thulu's side. Try again, and if it fails again, tell whoever runs Thulu.
sandbox.show_log: Show what the init script printed

queued.one: 1 run waits for the Sandbox to start from {branch}.
queued.other: {count} runs wait for the Sandbox to start from {branch}.

cause.browser_image: Thulu could not pull the browser image; tell whoever runs this installation.
cause.runner_start: Thulu could not start the runner; tell whoever runs this installation.
cause.runner_exit: The runner stopped before it finished. Try running it again; if it happens again, tell whoever runs this installation.
cause.deadline: The batch ran past its time limit and was stopped.
cause.daemon_restarted: Thulu restarted while this batch ran. Run it again.
cause.runner_lost: The runner stopped before this run finished. Run it again.
